top_signals.title: Japan’s Takaichi to Attend APEC in China if Parliament Allows
top_signals.summary: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said she plans to attend the APEC leaders summit hosted by China if parliament permits, confirming her willingness to visit amid a deep freeze of ties between the two Asian economies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Fairfax’s Watsa Bets On IDBI Payoff As India Booms, Report Says
top_signals.summary: Canadian billionaire Prem Watsa is betting that his Fairfax Financial Holdings Ltd.’s acquisition of IDBI Bank Ltd. will pay off given India’s growth prospects, the Economic Times reported.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Stablecoin remittances cost 84% less than traditional transfers, report finds
top_signals.summary: Borderless.xyz data shows major savings on cross-border business payments, with stablecoin transfers also settling faster than traditional international bank wires.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
